title: A long turn gets an automatic recap while the agent is still working
expected: Mid-turn the migration shows as in progress and nothing as not addressed. After the turn it shows as done and where things stand no longer says work is under way.

steps.user: Migrate all 30 API route handlers from Express to Fastify and fix the tests as you go.

steps.agent: Starting with the auth routes because everything else depends on the session plugin. So far: I replaced the Express app with a Fastify instance in src/server.ts, registered the cookie and session plugins, and moved the error handler to setErrorHandler so the JSON error shape stays the same. The auth routes (login, logout, refresh, me) are on Fastify now with their schemas declared, and their 24 tests pass after I swapped supertest for app.inject. The middleware that attached req.user is a preHandler hook now; it runs for every route under /api and skips /api/public. Next come the catalog routes (list, detail, search), then cart, then checkout and orders, and the admin routes last because they share the CSV export helper that still calls res.write directly. I am converting the catalog routes now: list and detail are done, search still uses the Express query parser and I am rewriting its validation as a Fastify schema. After each group I run that group's tests before moving on, so a failure points at one group. 6 of 30 handlers are migrated so far, and the server boots and serves the migrated routes alongside the Express ones through a small bridge I will delete at the end.

check.why: a long turn is recapped while it runs
nothing the user asked for is left unaddressed

steps.agent: All 30 route handlers run on Fastify now and the full test suite passes (212 tests). Express is removed from package.json.
